proposals.rule: When a 1099-K is added to gross receipts on top of book revenue, check the books' deposit detail. If it shows the same card receipts were already deposited gross into sales, the 1099-K must not be added a second time.
compares: books deposit detail amounts tied to the 1099-K payer
proposals.firesWhen: The books deposit detail names the 1099-K processor and shows an amount equal to the 1099-K box 1a already recorded in sales.
proposals.silentWhen: No deposit detail ties the 1099-K amount to booked sales, or the books show the card receipts recorded net or left out.

proposals.rule: Stock sales from RSU or ESPP shares that the broker reports with blank or zero basis must take the adjusted basis from the stock plan supplement when the lot dates match.
compares: stock plan supplement adjusted basis by acquisition and sale date
proposals.firesWhen: An 8949 lot's basis is zero or blank and the supplement lists a lot with the same acquisition and sale dates and a positive adjusted basis.
proposals.silentWhen: The lot basis already equals the supplement's adjusted basis, or no supplement lot matches.

proposals.rule: Mortgage interest taken from a payoff statement must not be added on top of a Form 1098 from the same lender when that 1098 says it includes interest paid at payoff.
proposals.firesWhen: The same lender's payoff statement and Form 1098 are both cited on the line and either document says the payoff interest is reported on the 1098.
proposals.silentWhen: The lenders differ, or the 1098 clearly leaves out the payoff-period interest.

proposals.rule: In the year a home is bought, the real estate tax deduction must be cut by the seller's tax proration credit shown on the buyer closing statement.
compares: buyer closing statement seller tax credit
proposals.firesWhen: A buyer closing statement dated in the tax year shows a seller credit for current-year taxes and SchA.5b equals the full-year levy.
proposals.silentWhen: No home was bought in the year, or SchA.5b already excludes the seller's share.

proposals.rule: A car deduction where the 1098-C box 4a (sold at arm's length) is checked must not exceed the box 4c gross proceeds.
proposals.firesWhen: Box 4a is checked and the claimed vehicle value is above box 4c.
proposals.silentWhen: An exception box (significant intervening use, material improvement, or given to a needy person) is checked, or the claim is at or below box 4c.

proposals.rule: For a part-year resident, California-source wages from an employer whose work location moved out of state must be limited to the period of California work, not taken from the full W-2 state box.
proposals.firesWhen: A paystub or W-2 note shows a work location outside California partway through the year while the California wage line uses the full box 16 amount.
proposals.silentWhen: All work for that employer was done in California, or the line is already prorated to the California work period.

proposals.rule: An estimated payment line may count only payments designated for the current tax year, and every amount must be backed by a confirmation or agency record, not by a client answer alone.
proposals.firesWhen: A counted payment's tax-year field shows a different year, or a payment's only source is a qa answer.
proposals.silentWhen: All counted payments show the current tax year and each is matched to a confirmation or transcript entry.

proposals.rule: A foreign-currency amount must be translated at an exchange rate for the same tax year as the income.
compares: fx reference year on the line
tax year of the source document
proposals.firesWhen: A line cites an fx reference for a year other than the document's tax year.
proposals.silentWhen: The fx year matches the income year, or a spot rate on the transaction date is used.

proposals.rule: Scan rental and Schedule C expense detail for replacement words such as 'replaced', 'installed new', 'system' or 'permit' on items booked as repairs, and route them for capitalization review.
proposals.firesWhen: An invoice behind a repairs line describes replacing a whole building system or component, or a permitted installation.
proposals.silentWhen: The invoice describes only routine maintenance or minor part fixes under the de minimis threshold.
